''See also: [[Aion Sea Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Aion]] Sea is a vast and perilous ocean formed by the death throes of [[Nakothi]], whose massive corpse remains at its center. The sea is characterized by a distinction between the shallows and the [[Deep Aion|deep Aion]]; while the shallower waters are accessible to lesser sailors, the [[Deep Aion|deep Aion]] is a realm of extreme danger filled with ancient [[Elders]], phantoms, and various monsters such as sharks, [[Kameira]], and the [[Soul Collector]] [[Kelarac]]. The environment is often unpredictable, featuring phenomena like moving islands, swirling walls of fog, and even storms where [[water]] rains upward. Navigating these waters is exceptionally difficult, often presenting travelers with a choice between significant delays or certain death. Only specialized [[Navigator ships]]—vessels constructed using parts of [[Elderspawn]] and operated by [[Soulbound]] captains—are considered capable of safely traversing the [[Deep Aion|deep Aion]]. Beyond its physical dangers, the sea is a place where the bizarre is common and where the influence of [[Great Ones]] can be felt, with some believing that anything lost in its depths is collected by [[Kelarac]].}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The [[Aion]] Sea is a vast blue expanse of [[water]] that can be navigated by an [[Imperial Navigator]] from the [[Guild]]. This haunted ocean is filled with numerous dangers, including various monsters and phantoms. The perils of the sea are significant enough that [[Calder]] suspects [[Naberius Clayborn]] might be taken a mile beneath its surface.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Aion]] Sea is a body of [[water]] located at the heart of the world and serves as a vital location where Navigators are required for business. Mentioned in a [[Navigator’s Guild]] report regarding [[Sleepless]] activity, the sea is a place that demands rapid action and quick decision-making. [[Jerri]] expressed great eagerness to visit the area, which is currently situated in a direction away from the [[Elders]]. [[Calder]] spent ten years with the Navigators crossing these waters, including the last five years sailing them, while the vessel Testament once sailed through its center. The sea is also known as the home of the terror known as the [[Cinderbeast]], and [[Dalton Foster|Foster]] would rather throw himself into its waters than obey an Elder.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Aion]] Sea serves as a body of [[water]] used for discarding objects, and it contains a nameless island. Within its expanse, [[Kell’arack]] was once nailed to the floor, while a bright and hopeful [[Intent]] drifts through the waters. [[Loreli]] is also located at this site. Recently, [[Jerri]] rose from the sea as a deeper and darker [[Shadow|shadow]] emerged from its depths.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Aion Sea]] contains a nameless island.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c10">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A source of bright, hopeful [[Intent]] drifts around the [[Aion Sea]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Aion Sea]] is a location where [[Loreli]] is.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Jerri]] rose from the [[Aion Sea]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Aion]] Sea is a vast body of [[water]] characterized by shallow areas that host rare Elder activity. This location served as the site where [[Kelarac]] was once nailed to the floor. From the [[courtyard]] of the [[Imperial]] Palace, [[Shera]] was able to look out across the expanse for miles into its depths. Following these events, Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine’s body rose from the waters, and the [[Heart of Nakothi]] was eventually kicked into the sea.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] could see from the [[Imperial Palace courtyard]] to miles deep in the [[Aion Sea]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine’s body rose from the [[Aion Sea]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref>}}</li>

</ul></div>
